correctness.rationale: Every graph endomorphism corresponds bijectively to a starting vertex and a closed ±1 step sequence; nonunit endomorphisms correspond exactly to zero-sum bridges. Their image cardinality is one plus the integer span. Weighted embeddings in finite paths establish the path-trace identity and exact finite difference. Reflection at the first maximum gives the binomial tail identity; sum of tails gives the exact first moment. Integer enumeration for n=4,6,8,10,12 checks histograms and moments but is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The full image-rank histogram and its exact first moment quantify typical compression in a natural finite transformation monoid. The √m growth gives a new asymptotic invariant: typical endomorphisms occupy a vanishing O(n^-1/2) proportion of the cycle, in contrast with automorphisms. These all-size structural statistics are not determined by the previously known monoid cardinalities or idempotent-only enumerations; they are motivated by classifying image ranks of all transformations, not an arbitrary slice.
